d: Deshbhar men shri guru nanak dev ji ka 557van prakash parv shraddha aur harshollas ke sath manaya ja raha hai. is avsar par gurudvaron men vishesh divan sajae gae aur shraddhaluon ne mattha tekkar sukh-samriddhi ki kamna ki. vahin, dev dipavli aur kartik purnima ke avsar par bhi deshbhar men dharmik anushthanon, puja-archana aur dipdan ke sath vatavran bhaktimay bana huaa hai. idhar, kendriy janjatiy kary mantri juel oram ne gumla men aayojit janjatiy gaurav divas samaroh men hissa liya. is dauran unhonne aadivasi samaj ke samagr vikas, kalyan aur adhikaron ke sanrakshan par jor dete hue…
